description: No debugger left in shipped or test code
what: A breakpoint() or pdb call is in a tracked Python file
why: The plugin runs unattended inside an agent session and in CI; a debugger stops the run with no one to answer it
fix: Delete the reported line. To see a value, assert it in a test under tests/.

description: No hardcoded secret outside tests/ (tests hold fakes on purpose)
what: A tracked file holds what looks like a literal key or token
why: This repository is public; a key in git history can only be rotated, not removed
fix: Remove the literal and read it from the environment the way checklist_runner.py reads GSC_CREDENTIALS_PATH; rotate the key.

what: feature_list.json is missing or contains a JSON syntax error
why: Invalid JSON breaks make vcr, verify-feature.sh and the feature state machine
fix: Run 'jq . feature_list.json' to see the parse error and fix the reported line.
